title: Docker Readiness
topic: Docker containerization readiness for local/staging API and containerized test execution
decision_summary: Docker containerization is implemented and runtime-verified for local/staging read-only API use with hardening. Host regression has 0 failures and ruff clean but test collection/count differs from Q26 baseline in the current working tree. Containerized full-suite test run has one known OS-specific failure (Windows-path semantics under Linux), not an application regression. Not authorized for production/live deployment; governance constraints unchanged.

manifest.generator_assessment: Script is Q16-specific (hardcoded root, phase/title/version/release_type set to Q16 release-candidate values) and performs a full filesystem walk over the current working tree with fixed excludes. Regenerating in-place would overwrite Q16 identity/metadata and include extensive uncommitted/unrelated working-tree changes, producing misleading release-candidate claims.
manifest.rationale: Regeneration is risky/misleading for current project conventions and working-tree state; manifest left unchanged.
manifest.recommended_process: From a clean/reviewed release scope, create or adapt a phase-appropriate manifest generator (do not overwrite Q16 metadata unless intentionally superseding it), confirm include/exclude rules and uncommitted file policy, then run `uv run python scripts/generate_release_manifest.py` (or the new deterministic generator) and verify the resulting manifest reflects intended Q27 artifacts and release conventions before committing.
